Even as China dominates global manufacturing output and expands its trade surplus toward $1.2 trillion, global capital remains heavily allocated toward developed markets.

title: Highlights From Fed Chairman Warsh’s News Conference
summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh speaks after the central bank's decision to raise interest rates by 25 basis points. Here are some of the key moments from Warsh's news conference. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: 'Direct Indexing' to Diversity Portfolios
summary: Manju Boraiah, Senior PM and Head of Systematic Fixed Income at Allspring Global Investment, reacts to Wednesday's Fed rate decision saying fundamentally, 'we needed the hike.' He also discusses how investors can break out from frozen positions, arguing that trillions of dollars of wealth is sitting in concentrated positions that are being held back by tax bills, and offers a possible solution to move toward diversification.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bond Traders Signal Warsh Credibility Growing in Inflation Fight
summary: The bond market is signaling growing confidence that Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh will act on his vow to tame inflation, which has exceeded policymakers’ target for half a decade.

title: Brown Harris Stevens CEO: We Need More Housing in Market
summary: Bess Freedman, CEO of Brown Harris Stevens, discusses a growing divide between affluent buyers and everyone else in the housing market. In response to a comparison with luxury consumer spending, Freedman says high-end real estate can often keep moving even when broader economic pressures, including Federal Reserve policy and higher mortgage rates, weigh on typical buyers. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Buildout Hits Inflation as Fed Hikes Rates
summary: Stephanie Aliaga, Global Market Strategist at JPM Asset Management, reacts to Fed Chair Warsh's remarks after raising interest rates. She argues that while oil prices are a long-term driver of inflation, the AI buildout is also having a significant impact. She argues slowing the AI frontier will help with adoption, and ultimately boost productivity. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Stocks Fall as Fed Hikes and Signals More to Come: Markets Wrap
summary: Wall Street traders drove stocks to the lowest since July on bets the Federal Reserve will keep raising rates to combat inflation after delivering its first hike in three years.

title: US Plan to Boost Biofuel Exports Targets Restrictions Abroad
summary: The Trump administration, following up on its efforts to boost domestic biofuels production, is taking the next step to help the industry: targeting policies abroad that limit uptake of fuels made from US crops.

title: Hawkish Warsh Lifts Dollar as Traders Bet on More Rate Increases
summary: The dollar notched its best day in three months on prospects that the Federal Reserve will continue to raise interest rates after Chairman Kevin Warsh delivered a stern message on inflation.

title: Bloomberg Deals 9/16/2026
summary: A weekly, midday program that delivers high-impact, editorially driven coverage of the most important corporate transactions shaping the global market. Today's guests: GFL Environmental Founder & CEO Patrick Dovigi, Norton Rose Fulbright Montreal Business Law Group Co-Chair, Partner Renee Loiselle, and Stikeman Elliot Partner Jeff Hershenfield. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Foreign Holdings of US Treasuries Fell to Nine-Month Low in July
summary: Foreign holdings of US Treasuries fell in July to the lowest level since October, led by declines in the stockpiles of France and Canada.

title: Market Repricing Fed Expectations, BlackRock's Rosenberg Says
summary: Jeffrey Rosenberg, portfolio manager of the systematic alternative ETF at BlackRock, reacts to the Federal Reserve's decision to raise interest rates by 25 basis points. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance: The Fed Decides." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Gold Swings Lower as Fed Tilts Hawkish After Raising Rates
summary: Gold swung lower after Federal Reserve officials signaled another rate-increase is likely this year, after raising on Wednesday for the first time in three years.

title: Warsh Gets a Credibility Boost
summary: The Fed unanimously raised interest rates for the first time in more than three years. Bloomberg Opinion columnist Jonathan Levin explains why this boosts Chair Kevin Warsh’s credibility. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: United, American Say Fuel Cost Surge May Mean Capacity Cuts
summary: United Airlines Holdings Inc. and American Airlines Group Inc. said they may need to cut more capacity in the fourth quarter, while Southwest Airlines Co. sees room to hike fares, as the aviation industry continues to contend with high fuel prices.

title: Canadian M&A Sentiment Amid Trade War
summary: Renee Loiselle, partner, co-chair of the Montreal Business Law Group at Norton Rose Fulbright Canada, and Jeff Hershenfield, partner at Stikeman Elliott, join Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." They discuss the current sentiment surrounding M&A in Canada after Prime Minister Mark Carney this week gathered some of the world’s top investors. Carney’s ambition is to use government money and private dollars to generate C$1 trillion ($720 billion) of investment over the next five years. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Canadian M&A Sentiment Amid Trade War
summary:
Bloomberg's Chris Palmeri joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." Authentic Brands, a licensor of everything from Elvis Presley’s image to the Reebok sportswear brand, could pursue an initial public stock offering as early as the first half of next year.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Lawmaker Requests Emergency Hearing Into Kennedy Center Closure
summary: A Democratic congresswoman asked for an emergency court hearing into the closure of the Kennedy Center, suggesting the move may violate a court order against an earlier attempt to shutter the Washington performing arts venue.

title: Carney Courts the World’s Top Investors at Toronto Summit
summary: Bloomberg's Melissa Shin joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." Canada Prime Minister Mark Carney is gathering some of the world’s top investors Monday night and Tuesday as he seeks to attract more investment into the country while reducing its reliance on the US and diversifying its markets. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: GFL CEO Dovigi Says Company Exploring Potential Take-Private
summary: GFL Environmental Inc. founder and Chief Executive Officer Patrick Dovigi said he’s open to considering offers to take the company private at a higher valuation than where its stock has been trading.

title: No Decision On Going Private: GFL CEO
summary:
Patrick Dovigi, CEO of GFL Environmental, joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." They discuss the possibility of taking his company private again in the near future.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
